name: Union Kitchen and Tap Gaslamp
notes: Router said no-platform on the homepage (site is behind a site-wide sgcaptcha wall, confirmed on / and /menu). Located the restaurant own Toast ordering page via web search (also linked from toasttab.com/local/...). Address in payload (333 Fifth Ave) matches work-list address exactly. Read the full catalog from the embedded __OO_STATE__ Apollo cache (brace-balanced, string-aware) rather than the fragile rendered-HTML regex: the DINNER Menu object groups[].items[] carry every item with a numeric prices[0] and outOfStock flag, matching the group itemCount metadata exactly (SHARE PLATES 15, FLATBREADS 4, SALADS 8, ENTREES 15, DESSERT 6, KIDS FOOD 7, SIDES 33, SPECIALS 2, Xtra Sauces 7, CONCERT DRINKS 5 = 102 total). 4 items are currently outOfStock (Chocolate Scoop, Vanilla Scoop, Fried Okra, Brisket Plate) but carry real prices and were kept. Cent-ending distribution: 76/102 (75%) end .95, 8/102 .00, 7/102 .25, 7/102 .50, 2/102 .20, 2/102 .45 - a printed-menu distribution. Divisor sweep (1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3) produced no cleaner two-value landing than the raw distribution - nothing divided out. Price level plausible for 2026 (share plates $11-24, entrees $18-36, sides mostly $5-9). Kept Xtra Sauces (condiment upcharges, $0.25-0.50) and CONCERT DRINKS (a small drink-specials section) as real orderable items, not adjuncts. PADRES and EMP FOOD menus in the payload are empty (itemCount 0) - genuinely empty, not unread. Sections reached: SHARE PLATES, FLATBREADS, SALADS, ENTREES, DESSERT, KIDS FOOD, SIDES, SPECIALS, Xtra Sauces, CONCERT DRINKS - no daypart gating observed, this is the full DINNER catalog plus the concert-drinks addendum.

name: Bobboi Natural Gelato
blocked: needs-browser: restaurant own ordering platform is Square Online (https://bobboi-natural-gelato-pickup.square.site/), which curls to a 54KB client-side shell with zero prices in the served HTML (confirmed, not assumed). The reachable order.online/DoorDash storefront for this exact address (8008 Girard Ave, La Jolla - confirmed match) lists 11 pint flavors at a flat $14.95, 3 multi-pint bundles, and 2 cone add-on packs via its escaped RSC MenuPageItem payload - internally consistent and not obviously fee-inflated on its own. But a WebSearch summary of the Square site (unverified since that page needs a browser to render) reports a single-flavor pint at $10.90 and a half-pint at $5.90, a real disagreement with the $14.95 order.online pint price rather than a small variance - per the disagreement rule this blocks rather than files either number. Additionally, this is a gelateria: the core in-shop by-the-scoop/cup/cone sizing (referenced in an unrelated review as a $5.50 medium cup) was not found priced on any curlable source - bobboi.com/our-flavors lists 16 flavors with zero prices (expected for a gelateria, priced by size not flavor), and no by-size price list was reachable without a browser.
notes: Do not use in place of a proper capture: no dishes captured this pass. Router said no-platform on the homepage (correct - homepage is a plain Wix marketing site). Confirmed the La Jolla store specifically via bobboi.com/la-jolla (address 8008 Girard Avenue matches exactly) before reaching for the order.online link, which is store-specific (slug ends in the same numeric id -33827403 that independent web search results also tie to the La Jolla DoorDash store).

name: Wood Ranch Mission Valley
blocked: needs-browser: router already screened out the DoorDash/order.online storefront for a baked-in fee (12% of 78 prices land on a conventional ending as published, 100% after dividing by 1.15). Checked the restaurant own site menu page directly: 290 items across Dinner, Lunch, Drinks, Kids Menu and Take-out Specials render in static HTML with ZERO prices (price span class="wr-price-new" is present but empty/unpopulated for all 230 items in those 5 core sections - confirmed by direct grep, not assumed) - prices are injected client-side, presumably per-location. Only Catering (39 items, party-tray "per guest"/multi-size adjunct pricing) and Happy Hour (21 items) carry real static prices; Catering is an adjunct and excluded, and Happy Hour alone with the entire Dinner/Lunch/Drinks core missing is a partial, not a menu, so nothing was filed. The restaurant own ordering platform is Olo (order.woodranch.com/menu/wood-ranch-mission-valley-san-diego, confirmed via serve-next.olo.com script tags) but it is a pure client-rendered Next.js app with no data in __NEXT_DATA__ or anywhere else in the served HTML - genuinely needs a browser, and no oloservice/v1/merchants REST path or location.woodranch.com host could be found without one.
notes: Do not use in place of a proper capture: no dishes captured this pass.

name: Volare Italian Restaurant
sourceUrl: https://volareitalianrestaurantsd.com/ (dine-in PDF: img1.wsimg.com/.../Copy of Volare, Dine-In, Single Sheets (1).pdf)
notes: Router said no-platform - correct, this is a printed-menu PDF restaurant, not an ordering platform, so no markup test applies. Two first-party PDFs are linked from the homepage: a Dine-In sheet and a Take-out menu; the take-out PDF confirms the address (3528 Barnett Avenue, San Diego, CA 92110) matches the work-list address exactly. pdftotext -layout paired most sections cleanly on single lines; -raw made pairing worse (separated all names from all prices into disjoint blocks) so -layout was used throughout. No embedded JPEGs in either PDF (checked with extract_pdf_images.js), so this is a text-layer PDF, not image-only. Both PDFs have real, unfixable multi-column scrambling in specific spots, and rather than guess a pairing every ambiguous row was DROPPED: (1) the PASTA section right-hand column on the dine-in dinner page (Capellini Puttanesca, Fettuccini Carbonara, Fettuccine Mediterraneo, Lobster Ravioli, Tortellini Volare, Gnocchi Romano, Rotini Alla Siciliana, Linguine Pescatore, Linguine Clams, Pappadella, Rotini Broccoli, Penne) shows 2+ stacked prices per item from wrapped descriptions bleeding into neighboring rows - none of these were filed; (2) in Chicken and Eggplant, Grilled Chicken and Chicken Piccata show two orphan prices ($17.95, $19.95) floating above the section with no name attached and the two items themselves show no price on their own line - both dropped; (3) in Carne, Bistecca di Ribeye has no visible price - dropped; (4) in Baked Pasta, "Lasagna" shows two competing prices ($14.95/$16.95) with no way to tell which belongs to it - dropped, but Lasagna with Eggplant ($16.95) and other single-priced rows in the same table were kept; (5) the take-out PDF Appetizers/Salads/Bread column was discarded entirely after Garlic Bread showed $12.95 there vs a clean $2.95 on the dine-in PDF for the same item - proof that column is misaligned; the dine-in Antipasti page numbers were used instead and cross-validate internally (Fried Zucchini $12.95 lunch-page name matches Zucchini Fritti $12.95 dinner-page name, etc). The take-out PDF has its own Sandwiches and Pasta price lists that differ slightly (generally $0-3 lower on some items, e.g. Spaghetti Marinara $13.95 dine-in vs Spaghetti w/Marinara Sauce $16.95 take-out - actually higher there) from the dine-in versions for overlapping dishes; rather than merge two documents into one row, ALL Sandwiches and Pasta prices filed here are from the dine-in PDF only, and the take-out PDF variant was not filed (a future pass could add it as a separate "(Take-Out)" section). Sections reached: Lunch Specials, Sandwiches, Antipasti/Salads/Sides, Pasta, Baked Pasta, Seafood, Chicken and Eggplant, Carne, Children's Menu, Pizza (by size 8"/12"/15"/20"/28", each style/size as one row), Beverages (beer/wine/soft drinks), Desserts. Cent distribution: 149/153 (97%) end .95, 4/153 end .50 (Coffee/Milk/Tea/Soft Drinks) - an unambiguous printed-menu distribution, no divisor test needed since this is not a marketplace/ordering platform. Price level plausible for 2026 (entrees $17-29, pasta $13-17, pizza $9-51 by size).
